verdict.rationale: Segment's docs describe a dedicated Consent Management feature to capture end-user consent preferences and a Privacy Portal for regulatory compliance (GDPR/CCPA/HIPAA), indicating some built-in mechanism to honor opt-outs and consent categories. However, the evidence pack lacks detail on how consent categories map to specific destinations or how the system actively suppresses/blocks downstream sends per opt-out, and there is no independent or hands-on verification of enforcement working in practice. Missing for 10: technical detail on per-destination consent enforcement logic, evidence of consent categories blocking specific destination sends, and independent/hands-on confirmation of reliability.
